thread:
harper.finance: Concordia Health raised a billing dispute. Invoice INV-5881 paid in EUR but our billing engine used USD rates for the reserved commit proration during region migration. They9re requesting a corrected invoice or a refund/credit to cover FX delta and a pro-rata commit mismatch.
nina.ops: Can ops attach provisioning audit and the exchange-rate snapshot used by invoicing? I recall we had an exchange-rate service TTL issue during the EU billing-region roll.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-5881: https://invoices.redwood/INV-5881.pdf
billing-bot: Metering summary: committed_hours=120 (expected), recorded_committed_hours=96; reserved_proration_applied=false; invoice_currency=EUR; exchange_rate_snapshot=2026-08-01T00:05:00Z USD->EUR=0.89
sylvia.sales: Contract CH-ENTERPRISE-2026 had a 4 GPU-month reserved commit. Onboarding migration moved the account from us-east to eu-west on 2026-08-01. There was a short window where the reserved PR was not honored and proration logic used the pre-migration UTC bucket. Customer noticed both lower committed hours recorded and an FX delta.
harper.finance: Quick econ: customer paid EUR 14,300 (converted at 0.89). If committed portion had been applied correctly and our intended EUR rate 0.93 segment used, they would have owed EUR 12,100. Net overpayment = EUR 2,200. Options: (1) reissue corrected invoice INV-5881-R1 with refund EUR 2,200 (legal sign-off if > 2k), (2) apply operational FX + proration credit EUR 2,200 and ledger note. Which do we prefer?
jun.revenue: For audit simplicity, prefer ledger credit + corrected PDF note unless customer insists on a signed corrected invoice. Approve credit up to EUR 2,500 to include rounding. Conditional on ops confirming root cause and adding a guard to the FX snapshot TTL.
nina.ops: Root cause: exchange-rate service cached a US-region rate for 6 minutes after the migration; proration job executed during that window and skipped reserved flag for some tenants due to a TTL race. We'll paste the query outputs for provisioning and the fx cache log.
nina.ops: Query: SELECT customer_id, sum(committed_hours) as committed_recorded, sum(expected_committed_hours) as committed_expected FROM metering.events WHERE customer_id='cust_concordia' AND month='2026-08' GROUP BY customer_id;
nina.ops: Output: committed_recorded=96, committed_expected=120
nina.ops: FX cache log excerpt: 2026-08-01T00:04:30Z cached_rate_usd_eur=0.89 ttl_expires=2026-08-01T00:10:30Z; migration_event: 2026-08-01T00:05:12Z region_switch=eu-west; proration_job_run=2026-08-01T00:06:00Z => used cached_rate_usd_eur
harper.finance: Thanks. Jun, please reply with explicit "approve" to allow finance to book ledger credit and create ADJ-2026-842 for EUR -2200. Also ops to commit PR for fx-cache short TTL guard and proration retry logic.
sylvia.sales: Customer prefers a credit applied to their account and a formal ledger note for auditors. I'll draft the CS message: "We found a migration timing issue where FX caching and proration timing caused your reserved commit and currency conversion to be misapplied. We've issued a EUR 2,200 operational credit and attached a corrected invoice PDF and ledger note. We've fixed the issue to prevent recurrence."
jun.revenue: approve\arlegal: legal-bot: For credits < EUR 5k, legal sign-off not required for issuance. If customer requests a signed revised invoice, escalate.
harper.finance: Creating ledger adjustment ADJ-2026-842 | customer: cust_concordia | amount: -2200 EUR | reason: fx_proration_migration_credit | linked_invoice: INV-5881. Finance will attach ops runbook and corrected invoice PDF (marked R1).
billing-bot: Ledger entry created: ADJ-2026-842 | customer: cust_concordia | amount: -2200 | currency: EUR | reason: fx_proration_migration_credit | linked_invoice: INV-5881
nina.ops: PR merged: fx-cache TTL guard + proration retry; runbook updated: https://runbooks.redwood/fx-cache-proration-guard. Monitoring alert added for mismatched committed_expected vs committed_recorded >5%.
sylvia.sales: CS notified customer; customer confirmed acceptance of credit and ledger note.
harper.finance: Closing loop. Finance booked ADJ-2026-842, ops fixed code, CS notified, ledger note attached. Will close once corrected PDF uploaded to invoice system. :white_check_mark:
